pages.name: Jiejie Li, "Elder Sister Plum" (Bone Flower Ancestor)

text.content:
Jiejie Li, the Bone Flower Ancestor, leads the New Promise Mandarinate's Extraordinary Commission and champions the radical notion that Kuei-jin and Kindred can coexist rather than annihilate one another. Her faction, the Harmonious Menders of Broken Fences, believes San Francisco can become a model of Kin-jin/Kuei-jin cooperation for the coming Sixth Age. Her second-in-command, the First Oni Chiu Bao, is a capable general and clever politician who keeps her enemies from exposing her throat to the August Courts.

Li's position is precarious: rivals like Maximum Sun of the Emerald Ministry spread rumors of a taste for human flesh and other degeneracies, and the conservative Foreigner-Vanquishing Crusaders work to drag her reformist agenda back toward destroying the Kindred outright. If she can navigate the political minefield and succeed, she stands to gain enormous power within the Blood Court — assuming the arrival of the Sixth Age doesn't render the whole struggle moot.

pages.name: Chiu Bao, First Oni and Devil Tiger Mandarin

text.content: Jiejie Li's second-in-command, Chiu Bao is an experienced general tested in the Midnight Wars and a shrewd political operator. Second Breath in 1631 CE, he presents as an unassuming country bumpkin while being one of the sharpest strategists in the Extraordinary Commission, deliberately pursuing his goals without exposing weaknesses to political enemies.

pages.name: Maximum Sun, Resplendent Crane Mandarin of the Emerald Ministry

text.content:
A rising star of the Blood Court, Maximum Sun sided with the conservative Foreigner-Vanquishing Crusaders and led the Emerald Ministry wu in the bloody conquest of Los Angeles. Politically, he is Jiejie Li's rival, serving as the Honored Ancestors' unofficial eyes and ears within the New Promise Mandarinate and hoping to profit from the reformist faction's eventual collapse.

His closely guarded secret is a Kindred curse suffered during the Los Angeles campaign: a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} hex (the caster since destroyed) that rots his innards and fills his body with maggots, which he masks with incense, heavy robes, and refrigerated environments, and slows only by secretly indulging in human flesh. Only Luna Demian, Regent of the San Francisco Tremere, is known to be capable of lifting the curse — a price Maximum Sun is not yet willing to pay.

pages.name: Hino Yorinaga, the Green Courts, and the Green Tigers

text.content: Hino Yorinaga leads a faction of Japanese Kuei-jin known as the Green Courts, allied uneasily with the New Promise Mandarinate but distinct from the Chinese-dominated Cloud Mandarins. The Green Tigers are their martial arm. Kim Jisun, Gaki, and Sakurai Mitsumune serve within or alongside this faction, each bringing their own agendas regarding the balance of power between the Mandarinate, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, and their own Japanese Kuei-jin heritage.

pages.name: Chan Te and the Hollow City Wu

text.content:
Chan Te leads the Hollow City wu, the primary agents of Yama King Mikaboshi in San Francisco and the true masterminds behind the akuma infiltration of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}. It was Chan Te's wu that captured, tortured, and spiritually broke the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue} Peter Kwan, turning him into an unwitting mole inside Jochen Van Nuys' own household. Chan Te answers to Mikaboshi and works patiently, subtly, and far more effectively than the akuma suffering heavy losses in Shanghai and elsewhere in the Middle Kingdom.

Johnny Ma and Tjun Tjun Afiff serve within Chan Te's circle, each looking forward to the day Mikaboshi's dominion over San Francisco's Wicked City can be declared openly.

pages.name: Wan Zhu and the Allies of Convenience

text.content: Wan Zhu is a Kuei-jin regarded by her own kind as "degenerate" for her willingness to deal with Kin-jin, yet her Chinese heritage and evident lack of affection for Western vampires make her an intriguing potential ally for isolated Cloud Mandarins like Maximum Sun, who considers approaching her about lifting his curse once he can verify her true loyalties.

A Hong Kong Kindred who fled to America when the Kuei-jin hunted Asian vampires after the 1997 handover, Kelvin Wee resettled in Seattle before answering the call to San Francisco. Rebuffed by the ineffectual Prince Van Nuys, Wee found a better rapport with Prince Sara Anne Winder and now serves as her secret back-channel negotiator with the New Promise Mandarinate, presenting her strategies as his own to keep her name clear of the stigma of appearing weak.

pages.name: Madam Xiu Ping and Father Li T'ien

text.content:
Madam Xiu Ping is a retired Shih (devil-hunter) who fled China after decades battling unbalanced shen. Orphaned by a Devil Tiger and trained (and used) by the devil-slayer Chu Fang, she settled in San Francisco, built a respected Kung Fu academy in Chinatown, and — alarmed by the growing Kuei-jin presence — has secretly begun training her best student as a new Shih apprentice to defend the West against the Ten-Thousand Devils.

Father Li T'ien is a Chinese dragon wizard (mage) who has lived in Chinatown for over 150 years, serving as its de facto spiritual authority on law, religion, medicine, and mysticism. He tolerates Kuei-jin who wish to converse with him but violently punishes any who feed on Chinatown's residents, and is deeply invested in reducing the Tongs' renewed drug trade in the neighborhood.
